note: Anchors and codes are rendered from rubric.json `definition` at run time (lib/rubrics/engines/consult-prompts.ts).
rules: Decide first whether the doctor audibly recommends an operation. A chart keyword is not a pitch; a local referral for surgery is still a pitch; a pitch is scored even if the operation is never booked.

If no operation is recommended answer {"surgery_recommended": false}. If the doctor audibly advises AGAINST an operation, answer {"surgery_recommended": false, "recommendation_kind": "no_surgery"}: the anti-pitch is still scored.
recommendation_kind is surgery, investigation, conservative, referral, no_surgery or other; only surgery and a contingent surgery have a pitch balance.
pitch_source is own, own_contingent (a plan that walks back to a scan first) or outside_surgeon.
only the speaking doctor's OWN recommendation counts: an outside doctor's surgery advice that is merely reported is not a pitch unless this doctor endorses it
a scope or endoscopic procedure (short, no admission) counts as surgery for this rubric (recommendation_kind surgery)

an optional offer ("not a must, your call"), with or without a date, is a surgery recommendation (a soft pitch); a stated decision or plan to operate also counts as a recommendation. This is not advising against an operation; V3 takes precedence over the no_surgery rule.
outside_surgeon is set only when this doctor endorses, or relays with endorsement, the outside doctor's advice; a reported outside advice without endorsement is surgery_recommended false
Benefits named: 'it is needed' does not count. Risks named: 'it is a small operation' does not count. Alternatives named: a work-up is not an alternative. Timing: urgent, elective or if-not-better.
Each named patient doubt gets one code: answered, partial, unheard, deferred_to_family.
Uptake of the surgery uses the seven chair codes. A prompted yes is accept with prompted_yes true; the family later is defer, not refuse; a logistics block is refuse.
Every evidence and doubt quote is copied EXACTLY from the transcript; never paraphrase.
Answer with ONE JSON object and nothing else.
user_header: CONSULTATION TRANSCRIPT. Times are mm:ss from the start of the consultation. Speakers: doctor, other (the patient and anyone with them), unknown.
